info.name: Malcolm Xavie API
info.description: Complete Postman collection for Malcolm Xavie backend routes.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Sign up, login, social auth, and token lifecycle endpoints.

request.description: Create a new user (Student, Tutor, or LocationOwner). Minors can be provided during sign up.
Exchange email/password for an access token and refresh token cookie.
Send a Google or Facebook token to login or create a linked user. Provider must be 'google' or 'facebook'.
Confirm the OTP delivered by email after registration or login retry.
Trigger a password reset email containing a one-time OTP.
Update password by submitting the OTP that was emailed via the forgot password step.
Authenticated users can rotate their password by providing the current one.
Use the refreshToken cookie to mint a new short-lived access token.
Clears the refresh token cookie and invalidates it server side.

item.name: Users & Profiles
item.description: Manage public tutor discovery, personal profile, beneficiaries, and minors.

request.description: Fetch public-facing data for a tutor profile along with computed student counts.

query.description: Optional search across name, major, bio

request.description: Public search endpoint with pagination, search term, and default 10 items per page.
Returns the authenticated user's profile including stripeAccountId when available.
Send multipart form-data to update profile fields and optionally upload a new avatar. Tutor/location owner fields accept JSON strings.
Set the bank account that will be used for withdrawals (required before requesting payouts).
Students can register their minors/children that will be enrolled into sessions.
Edit a minor's demographic information.
Remove a minor profile so it can no longer be scheduled into new sessions.

item.name: Tutors & Availability
item.description: Apply to be a tutor and keep availability calendars updated.

request.description: Authenticated users submit occupation, education, and KYC documents. Files are uploaded as multipart form-data.
Tutors maintain both weekly default availability and custom overrides for specific dates.
Public endpoint for students to view open calendar slots for a specific tutor.

item.name: Sessions
item.description: Browse, book, create, and manage tutoring sessions for every role.

request.description: Public catalog of tutor-created session offers. Supports search and pagination.
Publicly view all active offers created by a given tutor with pagination.
Fetch a fully populated session record including tutor info, location, and enrollments.
Role-aware sessions list. Use the tab parameter to switch between upcoming/request/history views.

query.description: ISO date to center the view

request.description: Calendar friendly view that returns sessions for the selected day/week/month window.
Students post a request for tutors to apply to. Tags and schedule can be sent as real JSON.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "STEM Mentoring for Teens",
  "description": "Looking for a weekly 90-minute robotics coaching session.",
  "category": "{{categoryId}}",
  "subCategory": "{{subCategoryId}}",
  "tags": [
    "robotics",
    "coding"
  ],
  "schedule": {
    "date": "2025-02-10",
    "startTime": "15:00",
    "duration": 90,
    "timeZone": "America/New_York"
  },
  "price": 75,
  "maxStudents": 3,
  "location": "{{preferredLocationId}}"
}

request.description: Student selects a tutor that applied to the request and finalizes enrollment for specific minors.
Students enroll their minors directly into an active tutor-created offer. Requires payment intent for paid offers.
Either tutors or parents involved in a session can cancel it. Tutors trigger full refunds, students incur platform fee.
Tutors craft public offers using multipart form-data. Schedule and tags are JSON strings; coverPhoto is mandatory.

formdata.value: Six week cohort focused on LEGO robotics.

request.description: Tutors respond to a student-created request by quoting an offer price per minor.
Tutor withdraws their pending application to a student request.
Quickly copy an existing offer to reopen it for a new cohort. Only available for the tutor that created it.
Student requests a time-limited QR code for a specific minor. Send the minorId in the body even though the route is GET.
Same as check-in but used after the session is complete.
Tutors scan QR codes to check minors in or out. Token comes from the student's QR generation payload.
Creators can edit their session details prior to any enrollments. Multipart form allows updating cover photo.
Remove a session that has never been booked. Otherwise cancel it instead.
Admin-only backdoor to mark a booked session as completed and capture held payments.
Deprecated in favor of /financials/sessions/:sessionId/create-payment-intent. Included for backwards compatibility.

item.name: Locations
item.description: Location owners can create venues while the public can browse approved spaces.

request.description: Browse approved & active locations with optional filters.
Publicly view a single approved location and its owner info.
Returns stats such as today's sessions, total income, and pending payouts for the location owner.
Authenticated location owners list every venue they have created.
Multipart endpoint used by location owners. Address and location fields must be JSON strings.
Send JSON body with any fields that need to change. address/location should still be JSON strings for parsing.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Downtown Learning Lab - Suite B",
  "address": "{\"street\":\"123 Main St\",\"city\":\"Austin\",\"state\":\"TX\",\"zip\":\"78701\"}",
  "location": "{\"coordinates\":[-97.7431,30.2672]}",
  "maxCapacity": 30,
  "rules": "Food only in lounge."
}

item.name: Home & Discovery
item.description: Personalized home dashboards and public discovery helpers.

request.description: Returns role-specific cards: students get categories/popular tutors, tutors get stats & leads, owners get venue KPIs.
Tutor/location owner specific 'My Panel' data such as availability, sessions, reviews, and owned locations.
Public endpoint listing every active category along with the count of active session offers inside each.

item.name: Financials & Wallet
item.description: Stripe payment intents, wallet overviews, and withdrawal requests for tutors/location owners.

request.description: Students pre-authorize payments for an offer/request. Provide numberOfMinors; tutorId is required when booking a request.
Confirm a previously created payment intent. In sandbox this will use Stripe test cards and leave the payment in requires_capture.
Tutors/location owners initiate a withdrawal that moves funds from available to pending and notifies admins.
Quick snapshot of wallet balance, pending balance, and latest 10 transactions for the authenticated user.
Paginated ledger of all transactions for the current user.
Alternative withdrawal endpoint (functionally similar to financials). Amount must respect minimum limits and beneficiary must exist.
Paginated list of all withdrawal requests initiated by the tutor/location owner.

item.name: Reviews
item.description: Students leave feedback for tutors or locations after a completed session.

request.description: Publicly fetch reviews for either a tutor (User) or location. subjectId is the tutor user ID or location ID.
Students can only review after the session is completed and they participated. rating accepts textual scale.

body.raw:
{
  "sessionId": "{{sessionId}}",
  "reviewSubjectId": "{{tutorOrLocationId}}",
  "reviewSubjectModel": "User",
  "rating": "Very Satisfied",
  "comment": "My child loved the pace and clarity of the lessons!",
  "evidence": []
}

item.name: User Reports
item.description: Users can report misconduct; lightweight admin helpers exist on the same route group.

request.description: Students/tutors can flag another user or entity. reportedUser should not equal the reporter's ID.
Admin-only helper exposed on the general route before the dedicated /admin/reports endpoints existed.
Admin updates report status directly from this legacy route.
Debug helper for admins/support to push arbitrary notifications. Requires auth even though not limited to Admin middleware.

body.raw:
{
  "recipientId": "{{userId}}",
  "type": "session",
  "title": "Session Reminder",
  "message": "Your robotics class starts in 2 hours.",
  "relatedId": "{{sessionId}}",
  "onModel": "Session"
}

request.description: List notifications for the logged-in user. Filter to unread items if desired.
Mark a notification as read.
Remove a notification entirely.

item.name: Chat & Messaging
item.description: Simple conversation API that supports messaging between two participants.

request.description: Send a message to another user and automatically create a conversation if it does not exist.
List every conversation the authenticated user participates in, sorted by recent activity.
Convenience endpoint to fetch history with a specific recipient. Sender metadata is populated per message.

item.name: Contact Us
item.description: Public contact form submission routed to the support inbox.

request.description: Send inquiries or support requests without authentication.

item.name: Stripe Onboarding
item.description: Stripe Connect Express onboarding lifecycle for tutors and location owners.

request.description: Creates or reuses the user's Stripe Express account and generates a link to finish onboarding.
Check whether the user has completed onboarding (details submitted + charges enabled flags).

item.name: Admin Suite
item.description: All admin-only endpoints are grouped by responsibility.

request.description: Paginated list of users with optional role/status/search filters.
Detailed information for a single user (password/refreshToken omitted).
Change a user's status (Active, Inactive, Blocked). Admin accounts cannot be changed.
Queue of tutor onboarding applications. Defaults to Pending.
Full document including uploaded KYC URLs.
Promotes the associated user to Tutor and marks the application as approved.
Reject and include a reason to communicate back to the applicant.
Powerful listing of every session (requests and offers) with search & filtering by status/payment/block states.
Inspect a single session including location, creator, tutor, and cancellation details.
View tutor vs location reviews tied to this session.
Force a status change (e.g., Cancelled) and optionally include a reason if canceling.
Toggle the isBlocked flag. Provide a reason when blocking.
Admin grid of all locations with approval + active filters.
Full details plus owner contact info.
Sessions held at this location with optional status filter.
Marks a location as approved and makes it active.
Sends the location back with a specific rejection reason.
Enable or disable public visibility for an approved location.
High-level totals for platform/tutor/location owner earnings.
Completed sessions with calculated earnings for each party.
Drill down on a single completed session's profit distribution.
Full ledger with optional search, type, and status filters.
Inspect a single transaction referencing users and sessions.
Create a refund transaction. Provide amount (+ reason). TODO note: actual Stripe refund integration required.
Centralized moderation queue with status + search filters.
Full details + polymorphic subject information.
Set report status to Open/Resolved/Closed.
Apply enforcement (resolve, block subject, etc.). action examples: resolve_and_warn, resolve_and_block.
Show pending/approved/failed withdrawal requests for tutors/location owners.
Inspect a single withdrawal request including beneficiary info.
Moves the payout to Processing, triggers Stripe transfer, and finalizes on success.
Return funds to the tutor/location owner and include the rejection reason.
Fetch the singleton settings document (profit distribution, withdrawal limits, etc.).
Update specific fields such as profitDistribution, withdrawal limits, or platform toggles.
Returns both Category and SubCategory collections for admin management.
Add a new root category.
Rename or toggle flags on a category.
Deletes a category and cascades deletion of its sub-categories.
Attach a new sub-category to an existing parent category.
Rename a specific sub-category or change metadata.
Remove a single sub-category record.
